quote: We consider a range of NLG evaluation datasets which have available ground-truth scores. For summary evaluation we use SummEval ... For dialogue response generation, we use TopicalChat ... For question difficulty ranking, we use CMCQRD ... Lastly, for story evaluation, we use HANNA ...

For summary evaluation we use SummEval (Fabbri et al., 2021) which has 100 articles each with 16 machine‑generated summaries evaluated on coherency (COH), consistency (CON), fluency (FLU), and relevancy (REL). ... For dialogue response generation, we use TopicalChat ... which has 60 dialogue contexts with six responses per context assessed on coherency (COH), continuity (CNT), engagingness (ENG), and naturalness (NAT). ... For question difficulty ranking, we use CMCQRD ... which has 658 multiple‑choice reading‑comprehension questions annotated on question difficulty. ... For story evaluation, we use HANNA ... which has 1056 machine‑generated stories annotated by humans on coherency (COH), complexity (CMP) and surprisingness (SUR).
